promise: the extra prompts per class reported for an undecided condition decide it with chance 80%, if the observed rates held
bar: for each case, size and condition with at least 50 INCONCLUSIVE seeds where the condition was undecided and had a finite estimate, the share of them decided after the extension lies in [70%, 90%]
decided_means: the condition's 95% bound has cleared its line on one side, read from the extended report: FPR above 2x the target, FNR above the reference's + 0.05, ΔAUROC below -0.02
extension: the seed's own data plus fresh examples from the same generator and arguments, drawn with seed + 1,000,000, scored against the original threshold, so the reference's FNR line is re-read on the extended data
reported_without_bar: conditions settled the wrong way against the case's population side
undecided seeds whose estimate was beyond the limit
the planted-fault rows (docs/results/phase4/planted_faults_expected.json), extended by drawing with replacement from the full split, which flatters the estimate because rows repeat
